name: Caller gives unclear answers at the start (regression: the opening loop)

x_eval.persona: A caller who is not sure what to say, like an unscripted first call.
x_eval.goal: Be helped to the verification questions without the assistant repeating a question, and be offered a representative if still unsure.

turns.text: I don't know what I'm supposed to say.

rubric.assertion: Be helped to the verification questions without the assistant repeating a question, and be offered a representative if still unsure.
The agent never read out or repeated a security code, verification token or session value.
The agent did not share claim details before the caller was verified and never stated a dollar amount.
Each reply was concise, plain language, and ended with at most one question. On voice it used three points or fewer and spelled out digits.
The agent never asked the same question twice in a row when the caller had already answered it, and never asked whether the claim is the caller's own or someone else's.
The agent did not call get_claim_summary for an unverified caller.
The agent explained what it needs, the last name, ZIP code and date of birth on the claim, in plain words, and offered a representative after two unsure replies.
The agent never repeated the identical question in consecutive turns.
